The ghost of the pirate {npc:Mr Brandon}, northwest of Rathleton, stole sacred treasures from the sea floor and is now cursed. Help him recover the wedding ring, return the mother-of-pearl slabs to the altars and find the time compass of the Sunken City, always with the help of the {npc:Guardian of the Deep Seas}. In return you gain access to the three zones of the {wiki:Seacrest Grounds|Seacrest Grounds} and, during the Fire-Feathered Serpent world change, three crystal shards, a Ring of Healing and two achievements.
A Fire-Feathered Serpent sleeps at the bottom of the sea, but its Guardian needs help to protect the realm.
No minimum level, but level 100+ is recommended.
For the extra mission of the Fire-Feathered Sea Serpent, the {wiki:The Fire-Feathered Serpent World Change|Fire-Feathered Serpent world change} must be active.
{spell:Levitate} to go down and back up in the Lost Mountains (west teleport) and in the extra mission.
or another diving helmet; without it you take drown damage underwater
one for Yeo (3rd slab) and another for the Altar of Life (extra mission)
only for the extra mission (Orb of Darkness)
only for the extra mission (Orb of Light); not consumed
Access to the Seacrest Grounds: Lost Mountains (west teleport), Sunken City (east teleport) and Birthing Grounds (north teleport).
Achievements **Mind the Step!** and **Snake Charmer** (extra mission during the world change)
Lost Mountains (west teleport of the Seacrest Grounds)
Mission *Souls Lost At Sea*: when you hand the {item:Brandon's Wedding Ring} to {npc:Mr Brandon}.
Sunken City (east teleport of the Seacrest Grounds)
Mission *Drowned Altars*: after repairing the three altars and talking to the {npc:Guardian of the Deep Seas}.
Birthing Grounds (north teleport of the Seacrest Grounds)
Mission *The Sunken City*: when you hand the {item:Time Compass} to the {npc:Guardian of the Deep Seas}.
Bring a diving helmet ({item:Helmet of the Deep} or similar): it is not required to enter, but without it you lose health from drowning.
Keep any {item:Seacrest Pearl|Seacrest Pearls} you find: you need one for {npc:Yeo} and another for the extra mission.
Your quest log records the progress of each mission (including the statues' phrases in the Sunken City).
{creature:Seacrest Serpent|Seacrest Serpents} are sacred animals: killing too many (3000 on the server) awakens the wrath of the Fire-Feathered Serpent and triggers the world change.

Oramond only has a boat from **Thais** (until you have the Citizen rank in the {wiki:Rathleton Quest|Rathleton Quest}). At Thais harbour talk to {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:oramond}, {key:yes} (150 gp). You land on a raft **west** of Oramond, next to {npc:Captain Gulliver}. Step into the {item:Slime Slide}: it takes you to a mound on the main island, where there are minotaurs. Go down to the ground floor and walk **east** to some buildings with a small boat: that boat's portal takes you across the water, closer to the city. From there go **north** to the main gate of **Rathleton**.
Mound where the Slime Slide drops you off
With the Citizen rank, the Slime Slide next to the boat takes you directly to Rathleton, without going past the minotaurs.

Leave **Rathleton** on the **west** side and head **northwest** to {npc:Mr Brandon}. On the way you will meet {creature:Devourer|Devourers}, {creature:Blood Beast|Blood Beasts}, {creature:Rot Elemental|Rot Elementals}, {creature:Glooth Blob|Glooth Blobs} and maybe {creature:Quara Scout|Quara Scouts}.
Say {key:hi}, {key:assist} and accept with {key:yes}. Mr Brandon lost his {item:Brandon's Wedding Ring|wedding ring} at the bottom of the sea and asks you to recover it.
Going down to the Seacrest Grounds

Step into the {item:Magic Forcefield} **south** of Mr Brandon, swim to the **north** side of the water and step into the {item:Maelstrom}. You appear in the {wiki:Seacrest Grounds|Seacrest Grounds}, near the {npc:Guardian of the Deep Seas}.

To leave the starting point: go up the ramp to the **east** and step into the **southern** Magic Forcefield, which takes you back to Mr Brandon. You only need to talk to Mr Brandon to start the quest; after that you can enter whenever you like.
Talking to the Guardian of the Deep Seas

Talk to the {npc:Guardian of the Deep Seas}: say {key:hi}, {key:wedding ring}, {key:something} and {key:will} ({key:assist} and {key:yes} also work). He wants you to free the souls of the 5 drowned sailors before he gives you the cursed gold.

Go up the stairs on the **right** and go down again by the **southern** stairs. In this area there are {creature:Abyssal Calamary}, {creature:Shark|Sharks}, {creature:Deepsea Blood Crab|Deepsea Blood Crabs} and Quaras.

Use the 5 {item:Pile of Bones (Quest)|Piles of Bones} scattered around the south area (see map) to get 5 {item:Drowned Seaman's Skull|Drowned Seaman's Skulls}. Each skull must come from a different pile.
Use a Pile of Bones (Quest) to find a Drowned Seaman's Skull. You need 5, each from a different pile.
Freeing the souls at the altars

Use each skull on an **intact** {item:Nacre Altar} (not a broken one). There are many more to the **south**, near the volcanic fissures. You can use all 5 skulls on the same altar. With each skull you get the message *"The skull crumbles into fine sand and is gone. This soul has been laid to rest."* To get back to the Guardian from the south area, use the shortcut in the next step or go the other way round (go up the southern stairs and down the right-hand ones).
Use the Drowned Seaman's Skull on an intact Nacre Altar (not a broken one) to free the soul. Do this with all 5 skulls.

Go back to the {npc:Guardian of the Deep Seas}. If you are far to the south, use the {item:Magic Forcefield} on a small hill as a shortcut. Say {key:hi} and {key:yes}: you receive the {item:Cursed Gold}.
Shortcut Magic Forcefield to the Guardian

If the {wiki:The Fire-Feathered Serpent World Change|Fire-Feathered Serpent world change} is active, the Guardian will not give you the Cursed Gold. Wait for the server save or complete the Fire-Feathered Sea Serpent mission first (section 5).

Go to the far **south**, to the {item:Hoard of Cursed Gold}. Use the {item:Cursed Gold} on the treasure to be transported behind it and open the blue chest: you receive the {item:Brandon's Wedding Ring}.
Use the Cursed Gold on the Hoard of Cursed Gold to get to the other side and open the chest to receive Brandon's Wedding Ring.
Step into the teleport to appear next to the four teleports. Use the **southern** teleport to return to {npc:Mr Brandon}.

Say {key:hi} and {key:wedding ring} to {npc:Mr Brandon}. He keeps the ring and gives you access to the **western Seacrest Grounds** (west portal, the Lost Mountains), where there are {creature:Sea Serpent|Sea Serpents} and {creature:Seacrest Serpent|Seacrest Serpents}.
Access to the Lost Mountains (west portal)
Mr Brandon also stole three nacre slabs (mother-of-pearl) from the sacred altars. You have to find them and put them back on the altars.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Mr Brandon}. He hid one slab in a barrel on a sunken ship and lost the other two.
Go down again through the {item:Maelstrom} and say {key:hi} and {key:mission} to the {npc:Guardian of the Deep Seas}. He will only help you with the other two after you find the first.

Step into the **west** {item:Magic Forcefield}. Here you will find {creature:Deepsea Blood Crab|Deepsea Blood Crabs}, {creature:Abyssal Calamary}, {creature:Sea Serpent|Sea Serpents} and {creature:Seacrest Serpent|Seacrest Serpents}.
Step into the west teleport to find the first and second slabs.
1st slab: the way to the sunken ship

Follow this route: walk a few steps **north** and use {spell:Levitate} down facing **east**; walk north and go down the stairs; walk east and pass a {item:Hot Geyser}; walk north and go down the stairs; walk north and go up the stairs; walk **northeast** and go down the stairs. You reach a sunken ship with a chest and barrels.

Use the {item:Chest (Quest)|chest} on the ship to get the {item:Nacre Slab (Blue)}. Go back to the {npc:Guardian of the Deep Seas} and say {key:mission}; he keeps the slab and tells you about the second one.

To get back to the Guardian, do the route in reverse: go up and down the same stairs and, at the spot where you went down with Levitate ({coord:33400,31802,13}), use {spell:Levitate} **up** (*exani hur up*) to the spot where the west teleport dropped you.
The first slab is on the sunken ship.
2nd slab: the way to the Secret Shrine

Step into the **west** teleport again and use {spell:Levitate} down a little to the north, as for the first slab. Then: walk **southeast** and go down the stairs; cross a larger room to the east, south and west and go up the stairs; walk **west** and go down the {item:Water Channel}; walk **northwest** and step into a teleport.
Use Levitate down here, towards the shrine.
Step into this portal to reach the shrine.

You are in a big whirlpool. Step into different {item:Maelstrom|Maelstroms} until you reach the **centre**. The route is different for each player, so try several routes. No whirlpool takes you to dangerous areas. In the centre, open the {item:Treasure Chest (Blue)|blue chest} to get the {item:Nacre Slab (Yellow)}.
The second slab is in the shrine chest. You have to find a way to the chest; no whirlpool leads to dangerous areas.

Go back to the {npc:Guardian of the Deep Seas} and say {key:mission}. He keeps the slab and tells you to ask Mr Brandon about the third one.

The wiki does not describe the exit from the Secret Shrine: return to the Guardian the way you came (teleport, stairs and {spell:Levitate} up at the same spot as for the 1st slab).

Go up and say {key:mission} and {key:Yeo} to {npc:Mr Brandon}. He thinks the third slab was fished up by old Yeo, at Rathleton harbour.

To go up: next to the Guardian, go up the ramp to the **east** and step into the **southern** {item:Magic Forcefield}, which takes you back to Mr Brandon.

Go back to **Rathleton** and look for {npc:Yeo} at the harbour, southeast of the city. Say {key:hi}, {key:fishing}, {key:interesting} and {key:use}. He swaps the slab for a {item:Seacrest Pearl}. To get there, walk back **east** to Rathleton, the same way you came.

With a {item:Seacrest Pearl} in your inventory (it may drop during the previous missions or you can bring one), say {key:hi}, {key:nacre slab} and {key:yes} to {npc:Yeo}. You receive the {item:Nacre Slab (Red)}.

Go back to the {npc:Guardian of the Deep Seas} and say {key:mission}. He gives you back the first two slabs. To go back down there, return to {npc:Mr Brandon}, step into the {item:Magic Forcefield} to the **south** of him and into the {item:Maelstrom} on the **north** side of the water.

Go down **one floor** to the altar room, right below the Guardian. Use the three slabs on the {item:Broken Nacre Altar|Broken Nacre Altars}: the **blue one on the left altar**, the **yellow one on the middle one** and the **red one on the right one**. The altars stay "repaired" for one minute.
Blue slab on the left altar, yellow on the middle one and red on the right one.
Go back to the {npc:Guardian of the Deep Seas} and say {key:mission}. As a reward you can enter the **Sunken City**, and he tells you about another {key:quest}.
Access to the Sunken City (east portal)
4. The Sunken City (Sea Ear and Time Compass)
Say {key:quest} to the {npc:Guardian of the Deep Seas}. He wants the protective amulet of the Sunken City: first you have to recover the **Sea Ear**, which Brandon stole.
Asking Mr Brandon about the Sea Ear

Go up and say {key:mission} to {npc:Mr Brandon}. He hid the Sea Ear in a shell in a cave and changes the whirlpool to take you there. Go up as before: ramp to the **east** of the Guardian and the **southern** {item:Magic Forcefield}.

Swim to the usual {item:Maelstrom}: it now takes you to a cave with rubbish, whirlpools and {item:Large Seashell (Quest Closed)|Large Seashells}. Open the shells: most contain {item:Some Broken Shells (Item)|Some Broken Shells}, a {item:Fishbone} and two {item:Fish}, nothing, or spawn a {creature:Crab}. One of them holds the {item:Sea Ear}.
With the Sea Ear, step into the **northwest** {item:Maelstrom} to leave the cave. Go back to the {npc:Guardian of the Deep Seas} and say {key:mission}: he sends you to the Sunken City.

Step into the **east** {item:Magic Forcefield} on the upper floor and look for the {item:Strange Statue|Strange Statues} in that area. Use the {item:Sea Ear} on each statue to hear a part of the song. If the statue says *return later*, go to the next one and come back in a few minutes. The order does not matter: walk back and forth until you have all five phrases. To go back to the Guardian, return to the spot where the east teleport dropped you and go the reverse way.
Check in the quest log that you have all five messages before going back.
Use the Sea Ear on the Strange Statues: each one may reveal a part of the song.
Finding out where the compass is
Go back to the {npc:Guardian of the Deep Seas} and say {key:mission}. The compass is hidden under the **Eternity Altar**, the southernmost altar, at the end of the volcanic range.
Go to the Eternity Altar and use the {item:Sea Ear} on the {item:Ancient Sundial}. You receive the {item:Time Compass}.
Use the Sea Ear on the Ancient Sundial to get the Time Compass.

Take the compass to the Guardian **quickly**: there is a teleport right north of the Ancient Sundial. Say {key:hi} and {key:compass} to the {npc:Guardian of the Deep Seas}. You gain access to the **Birthing Grounds** (north teleport).
Access to the Birthing Grounds (north teleport)
The quest now shows as *Completed* in the quest log, but there is still an extra mission if the Fire-Feathered Serpent world change is active.
The teleport right north of the Ancient Sundial takes you back to the Guardian of the Deep Seas faster.
Leaving the Seacrest Grounds and Oramond

To leave the Seacrest Grounds: next to the Guardian, go up the ramp to the **east** and step into the **southern** {item:Magic Forcefield}; you return to {npc:Mr Brandon}, from where you walk **east** to Rathleton. To go back to the mainland, go the reverse way to {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft (with the Citizen rank, the Slime Slide in Rathleton takes you directly to the boat). Say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (150 gp) to return to Thais. With the Citizen rank he also takes you to **Edron**, **Venore**, **Port Hope** and **Krailos**; **Issavi** is always available.
5. The Fire-Feathered Sea Serpent (only during the world change)

When **3000 {creature:Seacrest Serpent|Seacrest Serpents}** are killed on the server, the {wiki:The Fire-Feathered Serpent World Change|world change} starts right away. The {wiki:Quaras|Renegade Quaras} stole or destroyed the sacred orbs that contain the hunger of the Fire-Feathered Sea Serpent, and they replace the Sea Serpents and Seacrest Serpents in the Seacrest Grounds. Only the Earth Everpresent orb survived.

Talk to the {npc:Guardian of the Deep Seas}: say {key:hi}, {key:beseeched} and {key:yes}. You have to recover three orbs and place them on the Everhungry Altar. You can ask him about {key:orbs}, {key:Darkness}, {key:Light} and {key:Life}.
the Mother of Worlds (the only one that survived)

From the Guardian, use {spell:Levitate} down and walk **northeast**. Step into the portal and walk **south**. Use a {item:Mind Stone} on the {item:Stone Snake Shrine} to get {item:The Orb of Darkness Eternal}. You earn the achievement **Mind the Step!**. To go back, go the reverse way: return to the portal and use {spell:Levitate} **up** (*exani hur up*) at the spot where you went down.
The Orb of Darkness Eternal and Mind the Step! achievement

From the Guardian, go to the {item:Altar of Life}, far to the **south**. The world change has altered the terrain a lot: you may have to go around the volcanic structures. Use a {item:Seacrest Pearl} on the altar to get {item:The Orb of Life Everchanging}.
Orb of Light: get the Bottle of Gloo

You need a {item:Bottle of Gloo}. You get one in The Gloud Ship mission of the {wiki:Oramond Quest|Oramond Quest} or by trading 10 {item:Shrimp} with {npc:Yeo}, at the harbour southeast of Rathleton. The bottle is not consumed, so it keeps being useful for other quests.
Orb of Light: repair the orb

Step into the teleport to the {item:Everhungry Altar}. Use the {item:Ashes} next to the energy to get the {item:Broken Orb of Light Undying}. Use the {item:Bottle of Gloo} on the broken orb to repair it: you get {item:The Orb of Light Undying}.
Place the orbs on the Everhungry Altar
Still at the Everhungry Altar, use each orb in the right place:

Go back to the {npc:Guardian of the Deep Seas} and say {key:mission}. You receive a {item:Blue Crystal Shard}, a {item:Green Crystal Shard}, a {item:Violet Crystal Shard}, a {item:Ring of Healing} and the achievement **Snake Charmer**.

To leave the Seacrest Grounds: next to the Guardian, go up the ramp to the **east** and step into the **southern** {item:Magic Forcefield}; you return to {npc:Mr Brandon}, from where you walk **east** to Rathleton.
Blue, Green and Violet Crystal Shard, Ring of Healing and the Snake Charmer achievement

After the extra mission, if you ask the Guardian for {key:mission} again, he says that now only the blood of the Renegade Quaras calms the Serpent: you must kill **1000 Renegade Quaras** on the server for the {creature:Seacrest Serpent|Seacrest Serpents} to appear again.
Nacre means mother-of-pearl, the material of the outer layer of a pearl.
Unlocked zones: Lost Mountains (west teleport), Sunken City (east teleport) and Birthing Grounds (north teleport).
